latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Wendian Starmap Skill as wendian-markethot-skill, enabling access to institutional-grade stock market intelligence via Wendian Starmap.
- Supports real-time market data (quotes, K-line/OHLC bars), global indices, and batch operations.
- Provides proprietary heatmap and sector rotation analytics for both intraday and historical analysis.
- Exposes endpoints for concept/theme lists, stock-concept linkage, trading calendar, and stock reference data.
- Requires API key from Wendian Starmap (register at markethot.wendian.net) for authenticated access.
